overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are built around the specific setting 'a responsible tourism project planning brief 17'. No task reuses scenarios, audiences, content points, or lexical anchors from previous tests. Forbidden concepts (e.g., 'peer learning project', 'pollution essay', 'touring holiday') are avoided. The essay notes are original; the review uses an app; the article focuses on volunteer tourism; the email is a response to a specific query. All prompts are concrete and answerable.
